Source history shows the original 2015 example used valueSet, commit 86db0921cc changed it to source in December 2017, and commit 1c78b00bec removed the stray space after source= in March 2018, matching the Jira comment that the issue was already fixed.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini, and operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml includes $translate-request.txt as a request example. Later ConceptMap work renamed the old source/target value-set context inputs to sourceScope/targetScope, and the already-published FHIR-41175 reconciliation explains the current sourceSystem/sourceCode example names. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-14068-specific community record that changes the source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current ConceptMap operation example and the active Terminology Service narrative both use sourceSystem, sourceCode, sourceScope, and targetScope, and targeted search found no stale valueSet request parameter in the relevant source locations.
